front.title: The MERKLE3 Incremental Scheme for ZONEMD

abstract.t:
The ZONEMD Resource Record affirms the integrity of whole DNS zones and helps verify their authenticity. It embeds a cryptographic hash of the zone data, collated in a configurable way. It is used as a checksum for zone transfers between name servers.
[RFC8976] defined a single ZONEMD collation scheme, SIMPLE. It is sufficient for small and infrequently updated zones. This document introduces the MERKLE3 scheme, targeting large, dynamic zones. It uses a Merkle tree to enable parallelism and incremental computation.
